content.headline: So - when did she become the Mrs Lovett you thought you knew?
The long road to her own story
content.body: 1846 a penny dreadful • 1847 the stage melodrama • 1936 the Tod Slaughter film • 1979 Sondheim • 2007 the Burton film • 2025 Lovett, in which she finally tells it herself.

content.headline: 186 Fleet Street
content.body: The legend puts Todd's barber shop on Fleet Street and Mrs Lovett's pie shop around the corner in Bell Yard - with a conveniently placed tunnel between them. None of it is true. All of it is excellent.

content.headline: "Founded on fact"
content.body: That is what Victorian readers were told. Historians have never found any evidence that Sweeney Todd - or his pie-making partner - existed at all.

content.headline: And her relationship with God
content.body: One Fringe critic ended their five-star review by recommending you pair this play with a long gulp of communion wine.

content.headline: One performer
content.body: A butcher's block, a whetstone, a knife, a cup, a hunk of bread. Everything else is Eleanor.
